label: Zip Fly (Metal)
description: A metal zip fly uses metal teeth, prized for durability and a more substantial, secure feel under heavier cloths. It is the workhorse closure for sturdier trousers and denim, standing up to repeated use better than a coil zip. The trade-off is slightly more bulk and weight behind the fly.
